content.details:
### 1. Initialize a knowledge base

```bash
km init ./my_kb
```

This creates:

```
my_kb/
├── index.json        # auto-maintained module index
├── config.json       # LLM provider + extraction config
└── .staging/         # pending modules awaiting review
```
